high_level_description: The image depicts a cosmic scene filled with numerous icy, translucent objects that resemble asteroids or comets. These objects vary in size and shape, with some appearing more spherical and others more irregularly shaped. They are scattered across a dark, starry background that suggests the vastness of space. The icy appearance of these objects is highlighted by their blue and white hues, which contrast sharply against the black backdrop. In the center of the image, there is a cluster of these icy bodies, some of which have a glowing core, giving them an ethereal, almost magical quality.
